parsed.name: 游戏手柄/操纵杆控制器
parsed.description: 一种带按键、摇杆或扳机轴的手持控制器，部分型号还带陀螺仪。设备可作为 Linux 输入设备读取，用于实验中的机器人或小车手动遥控，以及按键、轴和转向/油门控制映射配置。
parsed.description_en: A handheld controller with buttons, sticks, and trigger axes, with some models also providing a gyroscope. It is used as a Linux input device for manual control of robots or small vehicles in lab setups, and for configuring button, axis, steering, and throttle mappings.
